title: Fix the Tuple Mutation
description: The program should update a coordinate pair to move it one step right. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print (4, 4), the point moved one step on the x-axis.
actualProblem: Tuples are immutable in Python, so assigning to point[0] raises a TypeError: 'tuple' object does not support item assignment.
explanation: Since tuple elements can't be reassigned in place, updating a 'coordinate' means creating a brand-new tuple with the desired values rather than mutating the existing one.
